device.name: manipulator-learning Panda Play insert tray (PyBullet simulation)

facts.text: The README loads environments with getattr(manipulator_learning.sim.envs, name); its example instantiates PandaPlayInsertTrayXYZState, calls reset() and unpacks the four-value step() result
Environment generation compatible with gym.make is an unchecked roadmap item, so the class has no registered Gymnasium id
PandaPlayInsertTrayXYZState documents a 59-value observation space and a 4-value action space
The observation layout is pos 0:3, vel 3:6, grip_pos 6:8, prev_grip_pos 8:12, obj_pos 12:26, obj_vel 26:38, obj_rel_pos 38:53 and force_torque 53:59

The class defaults are max_real_time 18 s, n_substeps 5, action_multiplier 0.002 and the insert task, with state_data pos, vel, grip_pos, prev_grip_pos, obj_pos, obj_rot, obj_vel, obj_rot_vel and force_torque
A full-magnitude action moves the desired position by 2 mm per substep over five substeps, 1 cm per environment step
PandaPlayGeneric passes grip_in_action=True, so the last action value is always the gripper command
The insert-tray class uses valid_t_dofs=(1, 1, 1) and valid_r_dofs=(0, 0, 0) with control_method 'dp'
The insert-tray workspace bounds are x 0.85 to 1.15, y -0.35 to -0.05 and z 0.665 to 0.8 in world coordinates
ManipulatorEnv derives num_actions from the translation DOFs, the rotation DOFs and grip_in_action and builds the action space as Box(-1, 1, (num_actions,))
The observation space is a Box from -inf to +inf with num_obs elements
The PBEnv default simulation time step is 0.01 s
ManipulatorEnv computes real_t_per_ts as time_step * n_substeps and _max_episode_steps as round(max_real_time / real_t_per_ts)
A step returns the legacy four-tuple (observation, reward, done, info) and sets done when ep_timesteps reaches _max_episode_steps
reset takes mb_base_angle and reset_dict, returns only the observation and has no seed parameter
The separate seed(seed=None) method delegates to the PBEnv seed and copies np_random
PBEnv creates an in-process BulletClient in pybullet.DIRECT mode when force_pb_direct is set

determinism.notes: the fake seeds Python's random.Random from reset(seed) or cap.world.seed.v1 and its transitions are deterministic, so one seed and action sequence repeat a fake trajectory; upstream PBEnv.seed uses numpy's seeding.np_random and PyBullet physics, so a seed does not give the same trajectory on the two implementations

gaps: the fake is an analytic F0 kinematic stand-in: it integrates the three translation values and the gripper command directly; there are no PyBullet rigid bodies, joints, IK, contacts, friction, actuator response, sensor model, cameras or rendering
the upstream environment is PyBullet rigid-body dynamics (F1); this package declares F0 because the delivered fake integrates no dynamics and was never compared with the upstream environment
the fake returns the full 59-value observation layout but only the pos, vel, grip_pos and prev_grip_pos slots are modelled; the object, relative-position and force-torque slots are zeros
the fake reward is the placeholder 0.0 and is not the upstream insert reward; done is the upstream 360-step time limit reported as the legacy terminated flag, not a Gymnasium truncation
the fake draws its start jitter with Python's random.Random, while upstream PBEnv.seed uses numpy's generator and PyBullet draws its own contacts; one seed does not give the same trajectory on both
reset options and mb_base_angle/reset_dict are not modelled: upstream reset takes mb_base_angle and reset_dict but no seed, so the bridge uses seed() followed by reset()
env_id is the class name, not a gym.make registration (README.md:172); the sim backend would call gym.make and cannot open this class, and no pybullet environment was imported or run
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, one bridge tick advances the 50 ms control interval (5 PyBullet steps of 0.01 s) only
snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes no get_state/set_state pair

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
